cues: Fixed prepositions: learn each pair as if it were one word.
Good at, afraid of, married to, angry with a person, interested in, famous for, proud of, different from, similar to, responsible for.
And verbs: depend on, consist of, apologise to someone for something, belong to, congratulate on, insist on, accuse of, prevent from, succeed in, object to.
